title: The macOS system must disable Screen Time prompt during Setup Assistant.
check_content:
Verify the macOS system is configured to disable Screen Time prompt during Setup Assistant with the following command:

/usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript << EOS
$.NSUserDefaults.alloc.initWithSuiteName('com.apple.SetupAssistant.managed')\
.objectForKey('SkipScreenTime').js
EOS

If the result is not "true", this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the macOS system to disable Screen Time prompt during Setup Assistant by installing the "com.apple.SetupAssistant.managed" configuration profile.
VulnDiscussion: The prompt for Screen Time setup during Setup Assistant must be disabled.
